defs.def: closely connected with the subject you are discussing or the situation you are thinking about 紧密相关的；切题的

ex.s: These exams, which students commonly use for practice, can give you an idea of how instructors ask questions and what they regard as relevant material.
ex.t: 这些学生常用来练习的考试，能让你了解老师如何提问，以及他们认为相关的材料是什么。

ex.s: providing relevant information and supporting services
ex.t: 提供相关信息和支持服务

ex.s: Our content is about real-life topics that are relevant because we know what matters to you is what sticks best You will, find it very rewarding to learn with Lancom.
ex.t: 我们的内容是关于现实生活中的话题，这些话题相关，因为我们知道对你重要的东西才记得最牢。你会发现，和Lancom一起学习非常有收获。

ex.s: Orientation Day is a way to welcome new students and help them know the school, including its history, campus, facilities and other relevant information.
ex.t: 迎新日是欢迎新生的一种方式，帮助他们了解学校，包括学校的历史、校园、设施和其他相关信息。

ex.s: You can also include photos, tickets, souvenirs, postcards, notes and anything else you can find that you think is relevant.
ex.t: 你还可以包括照片、门票、纪念品、明信片、笔记以及任何你能找到的你认为相关的东西。

ex.s: First, identify the title and author of the piece.Then use your own words to describe relevant details that lead to the climax of the story.
ex.t: 首先，确定作品的标题和作者。然后用你自己的话描述导致故事高潮的相关细节。

ex.s: Nonetheless, what is in no doubt is that the sharing economy is increasingly relevant to our daily lives as well as to the global economy.
ex.t: 尽管如此，毫无疑问的是，共享经济与我们的日常生活以及全球经济越来越息息相关。

defs.def: having ideas that are valuable and useful to people in their lives and work 有价值的；有意义的

ex.s: Often students come to the classroom believing that learning can’t be fun and that what they learn isn’t relevant to the real world — much less to their personal interests.
ex.t: 学生们常常带着这样的看法走进教室：学习不可能有趣，所学内容与现实世界无关——更谈不上与他们的个人兴趣有关。

ex.s: I’ve discovered that if I show students how what they learn is relevant to my hobbies, they’re much more willing to make connections to their personal interests and develop their own hobbies.
ex.t: 我发现，如果我向学生展示所学内容与我的爱好的关联，他们就更愿意把知识与自己的兴趣联系起来，并培养出自己的爱好。

ex.s: Confucius identified the concept ren as the most important principle in life, a principle which is still relevant in modern society.
ex.t: 孔子将"仁"这一概念确定为人生的最重要原则，这一原则在现代社会仍然具有现实意义。
